card.title: IPad 10.2in 8th Gen Not turning on, drawing between 0-0.2A, tristar is functional repair

source.title: IPad 10.2in 8th Gen Not turning on, drawing between 0-0.2A, tristar is functional repair

claims.statement: An iPad 8 cycling 0–0.3 A with a flashing screen and a working Tristar was caused by the PMIC not outputting GPIO_PMU_TO_LCD_PWREN; replacing the PMIC fixed it.

procedure: Confirm Tristar OK and the cycling draw.
card.caveats: Single case. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
